Other words

  • discrīminō, discrīmināre — part (the hair)

    verb, first conjugation · also used · late Latin · Vulg. Judith 10.3: crīnem (Lewis & Short); Traupman 167

    Classically “divide, separate”; of the hair only in the Vulgate.
